normalized.result: Yes, expanding the note right on the card feels right. A long note starting folded so my list stays easy to skim, then opening up in place when I click "Show full note" — with the bold, the bullet list, and the link all still properly formatted — is just what I'd want, and I can fold it back with "Show less." And having a stack of labels simply wrap onto the next line rather than breaking the card works fine for me. Those boundary behaviors are good.
